title: HISTORY: Marie Antoinette ordered a Breguet in 1783. It was finished in 1827.
hook: Marie Antoinette Ordered A Breguet. It Took 44 Years To Finish.
why: The story of one famous watch (Breguet No. 160) with a tension hook. A date plus a fact alone flops, so the hook carries the 44-year gap. It does not repeat the Genta post.
